The orchestrator independently confirmed the top-line mechanism the slice boundary rests on: win/tty/topl.c:264 appends only while `n0 + strlen(toplines) + 3 < CO - 8`, and :265 exempts "You die", so screen 103's --More-- is raised by potionbreathe()'s own message and a slice stopping at zap.c:5917 would earn no screen at all. The attestation this field will hold is the worker's to earn and the orchestrator's to verify.
